name: Unnecessary Move
hint: This smell identifies a motion block with the literal value zero, such as [move (0) steps] or changing X or Y by zero. The block cannot change the sprite's position and makes the script harder to read.
instruction: Remove the zero movement, or replace it with an intentional value when the sprite should actually move.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
move (0) steps
